description: A request parameter chosen as the method name of getMethod is unsafe reflection (the method-level twin of Class.forName(tainted)).  A literal method name and the servlet's own request.getMethod() are not.  The java.reflection.method_invoke pattern fires on the Method value either way, so it cannot tell the two apart.

expected.notes: constant method name, and HttpServletRequest.getMethod() takes no name
request.getMethod() is not a structural sink
